GenAiPlugin.description: This topic is selected when user requests need to be prioritized based on urgency and criticality.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: If the query is about prioritizing requests, assess the urgency and criticality of each request.
Once the urgency is determined, prioritize the requests accordingly.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Your job is to only prioritize user requests by assessing their urgency and criticality. You aren't able to handle routine requests.
